报告元数据.主营业务: 全球领先的"炼油-化工-化纤"一体化产业链企业，形成"聚酯+尼龙"双引擎模式
报告元数据.企业名称: 恒逸石化股份有限公司

环保投资.原文: Invested in environmental protection RMB 850 million（ESG Highlights in 2025, P6）；Invest in Environment million 522 400 850（Appendix ESG Key Performance, P69）

环境管理体系.值: 公司建立了HSE管理委员会（由董事长担任主任），各子公司设立HSE领导小组并持续完善安全管理体系；供应商准入将环境管理体系纳入招标资格要求
环境管理体系.原文: We have established an HSE Management Committee, chaired by the Chairman of the Board... Each subsidiary establishes an HSE leading group and continuously improves its safety management system（Work safety management, P22）；Supplier quality management system, environmental management system, occupational health and safety management system, environmental impact assessment results, and pollutant discharge permit status are incorporated into bidding qualification requirements（Supplier full life-cycle management process, P31）

碳管理体系建设.值: 公司已全面将气候相关事项纳入ESG管理框架，董事会监督气候战略和目标的制定与执行，HSE管理委员会负责协调；以《碳达峰行动方案》为指导开展碳减排行动
碳管理体系建设.原文: The Company has fully integrated climate-related matters into its ESG management framework. The Board of Directors oversees the development and execution of climate strategy and targets. The HSE Management Committee is responsible for coordinating... Guided by the Carbon Peaking Action Plan, the Company carries out carbon reduction initiatives（Climate Change Response, P45）

碳总量.原文: Carbon dioxide emissions 10,000 tons 809 794 799（Appendix ESG Key Performance, P69）；Total CO2 emissions 7.99 million tons（ESG Highlights in 2025, P6）

碳排放强度.原文: Carbon dioxide emissions intensity million tons/RMB billion 0.06 0.06 0.07（Appendix ESG Key Performance, P69）

碳排放抵消与同比变化.值: 2025年碳排放总量799万吨，较2024年794万吨略有上升；2023年为809万吨
碳排放抵消与同比变化.原文: Carbon dioxide emissions 10,000 tons 809 794 799（Appendix ESG Key Performance, P69）

能源类型和强度.值: 主要能源类型包括原煤、外购电力和天然气；2025年原油消耗881万吨，煤炭消耗247万吨；工业淡水消耗3151万吨，工业淡水消耗强度0.28百万吨/十亿元
能源类型和强度.原文: The Company's energy consumption and carbon emissions primarily originate from production operations, involving energy sources such as raw coal, purchased electricity, and natural gas（Energy efficiency, P44）；Consumption of crude oil 10,000 tons 819 848 881；Consumption of coal 10,000 tons 187 193 247；Industrial Freshwater Consumption 10,000 tons 5,161 4,086 3,151；Industrial Freshwater Consumption Intensity million tons/RMB billion 0.38 0.33 0.28（Appendix ESG Key Performance, P70）

能耗同比变化.值: 2025年原油消耗881万吨（2024年848万吨，2023年819万吨），煤炭消耗247万吨（2024年193万吨，2023年187万吨），均呈上升趋势
能耗同比变化.原文: Consumption of crude oil 10,000 tons 819 848 881；Consumption of coal 10,000 tons 187 193 247（Appendix ESG Key Performance, P70）

节能目标与改造情况.值: 公司推进清洁能源替代，2025年新增光伏装机132.896MW，累计光伏装机258.836MW，年发电量165.71GWh；部署储能容量113MW，年充电量29.72GWh；实施锅炉先进控制系统、余热回收发电、淘汰高能耗电机和设备等节能措施
节能目标与改造情况.原文: In 2025, the Company added 132.896MW of new PV installed capacity, bringing cumulative PV installed capacity to 258.836 MW, with annual power generation of 165.71 GWh. Through energy storage systems for peak shaving and valley filling, the Company deployed a cumulative energy storage capacity of 113 MW, with annual charging volume of 29.72 GWh（Clean energy substitution, P47）；The Company advances its energy conservation and emissions reduction plan through a range of measures: phasing out high-energy-consumption motors and equipment, adopting advanced process control technologies, implementing energy efficiency retrofit projects, and optimizing production processes（Energy conservation and consumption reduction, P48）

供应商碳披露及评价要求.值: 供应商需提交检验报告以确保合规性和透明度；定期邀请供应商完成《供应商可持续发展自评问卷》以动态评估供应商表现
供应商碳披露及评价要求.原文: Suppliers are required to submit inspection reports to ensure compliance and transparency（Supplier full life-cycle management process, P31）；Suppliers are invited to complete the Supplier Sustainability Self-Assessment Questionnaire periodically to dynamically evaluate supplier performance（Supplier evaluation, P31）

供应商绿色采购标准.值: 供应商准入将质量管理体系、环境管理体系、职业健康安全管理体系、环境影响评价结果和排污许可证状态纳入招标资格要求；与所有正式供应商签署《反商业贿赂与廉洁协议》和《阳光采购协议》
供应商绿色采购标准.原文: Supplier quality management system, environmental management system, occupational health and safety management system, environmental impact assessment results, and pollutant discharge permit status are incorporated into bidding qualification requirements（Supplier full life-cycle management process, P31）；The Company signs the Anti-Commercial Bribery and Integrity Agreement and the Sunshine Procurement Agreement with all formal suppliers（Supplier engagement, P31）

供应商激励.值: 公司定期开展供应商绩效评估，根据评估结果对供应商进行分类和激励；举办年度优秀供应商颁奖典礼，共65家优秀供应商和120余名企业代表参加
供应商激励.原文: The Company conducts regular supplier performance evaluations and assessments, and classifies and incentivizes suppliers based on evaluation results（Supplier evaluation, P31）；A total of 65 outstanding suppliers and over 120 corporate representatives attended the conference to strengthen partnerships and explore collaborative development（2025 annual outstanding supplier award ceremony, P33）

循环经济链塑造.值: 公司建立了完整的废旧纺织品回收网络，通过"逸回收"品牌构建线上线下全渠道回收体系；化学回收技术将消费后纺织品废料解聚回收聚酯单体，实现纤维到纤维的闭环回收；2025年投资建设年产30万吨再生新材料工业示范项目
循环经济链塑造.原文: We have also established a comprehensive waste textile recycling network to enable resource reuse and environmentally responsible development（Chairman's Statement, P5）；We have successfully developed a chemical depolymerization technology for recycling post-consumer textile waste. The resulting products match the quality of virgin polyester and can be processed into recycled polyester chips and fibers... achieving closed-loop R&D from textile waste to new materials. In 2025, we invested in building a 300,000-ton-per-year recycled new materials industrial demonstration project（Recycled Materials from Waste Textiles, P35）

绿色物流.值: 恒逸物流于2025年3月25日在海宁基地接收五辆氢能卡车，正式启动联合氢能H2aaS一体化服务包，开启零碳货运新篇章；以氢燃料替代传统燃料，减少物流碳排放
绿色物流.原文: On March 25, 2025, Hengyi Logistics took delivery of five hydrogen-powered trucks at its Haining base and officially activated the United Hydrogen H2aaS integrated service package, opening a new chapter in zero-carbon freight... By replacing conventional fuel with hydrogen fuel, the initiative reduces logistics carbon emissions（Hengyi Logistics hydrogen-powered truck delivery, P48）
